layout_summary: A two-column movie-poster pastiche on pure white: a cut-out CGI object stack (red stiletto pouring into a spread jar) occupies the left third from the top edge down to 82% height, while a four-line stacked serif title sits alone in the right half between 31% and 55% height. One bold sans caption runs full-width across the bottom, leaving a very large empty white field in the lower-right quadrant.

scene.subject: A glossy lacquered red stiletto pump, pointed toe up and to the right, its stiletto heel melting downward into three thin rope-like strands of thick caramel-brown spread that pour into the open mouth of a stubby cylindrical glass jar below; the spread floods over the jar's rim and runs in heavy drips down the outside of the glass, pooling in one blob at the lower right of the jar base. The jar carries a red wrap-around paper label with a gold lozenge badge and a caramel-coloured biscuit tucked against its right side. Both objects are cut out against empty ground with no horizon, no surface and no cast shadow.
scene.composition: Object stack fills the left third only and bleeds off the left canvas edge: the shoe enters top-centre-left with its toe at y=10%, runs diagonally down-left and exits the left edge between y=38% and y=46%; its heel drops on the x=24.5% axis into the drip stream (y=48-57%), which lands in the jar (x=14.5-34.6%, y=55.6-82.5%). Jar is roughly one fifth of canvas width, shoe about one third. Vertical stacked read, top to bottom, with ~72% of the canvas height used by the object column.
scene.camera: Straight-on, eye-level product/packshot view with near-zero perspective distortion; long-lens feel (~85-100mm), everything in focus front to back, no depth-of-field falloff, objects isolated as clean cut-outs.
scene.lighting: Broad soft key from upper-left-front with a second soft rim on the right; long specular highlights run the length of the shoe's patent upper and the heel, warm bounce fills the caramel so the drips read translucent at their edges; neutral-to-slightly-warm white, no visible ground shadow or contact shadow.

why_it_works: Hard split of duties: the whole left third is one continuous top-to-bottom object sentence (shoe → pour → jar), so the entire right half stays empty white for type — nothing overlaps, nothing competes.
The red–black–red–black title stack sets its own internal hierarchy by size alone (DEVIL at 105px cap vs EATS at 40px), so the eye reads the joke in the right order without any rule, box or scrim.
One saturated red runs through the shoe, the two small title lines and the caption, tying the two columns together across 11% of empty gutter; everything else is black on white.
